title: Garmin Forerunner 965 $663.91 (RRP $999) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Garmin Forerunner 965 $663.91 (RRP $999) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[WorkingLowJam] The flashlight is definitely handy and I talk to the phone to set timers and change modes. Have taken a few phone calls on it too, not the best microphone quality but it does the job.
I have hit the screen multiple times expecting scratches, but there are still zero marks, I guess the sapphire glass does its job, this is probably the biggest feature!
Where are you getting the 970 for $900+ ?
[Spizz] Same question. Where do you get the 970 for $900 odd?
[Assburg] Can confirm the flashlight on the Garmin is elite. Though I've got a fenix, which has red light as well, unsure about the others but…
fumbling around for keys/unlocking door in the dark
peeing in the dark
checking data tables/calculating aim off in the dark
pretty much anything you'd use a phone torch for as well..
All taken care of by Garmin.
[kungfuman] I get 21 days on my Xiaomi watch s5 and costed me 220 delivered on special
[kitebud] do you mind sharing where you bought it from ?
[cephh] Amazon has it for $226.56, but it's from japan not sure if theres any difference though!
[SpaceNinja] Well, that $999 RRP was in March 2023 when it got released.
[toddls] Yep, Garmin RRP already feels like it’s built with health fund discounts in mind too
[CheapGit] It's been $663.91 for a few days now from Ryda via the Woolworths Everyday Marketplace, (black strap version not available now) plus there's been cashback offers up to 30% during this time.
[kevinthresh] you can get Garmin Epix Pro Gen 2 for less than $800 now, except weight is slightly heaver, epix series is better than FR in any other aspects.
[CheapGit] You sure it's the Pro model and not just the standard Epix Gen 2?
[icarus255] This or wait for Venu4 to go on sale? I'm not a triathlon bro. I just want the long battery life, health features like ECG, good sleep tracking, and some of the quality of life features that's missing in my Venu 2.
